column1: A ball is suspended from the ceiling, pushed sideways horizontally, and then released to observe its back-and-forth swinging motion. A uniform cube is pushed off the edge of a table, observing its flipping and falling process. The center of a rectangular wooden board is fixed on an axis, then a force is applied to one end to observe the board's rotation. A long, thin rod is fixed at one end to the wall, with a weight hanging from the other end, observing the degree of bending of the rod. A rectangular board is fixed at its center, and a force is applied to make it swing within the horizontal plane. A disc is fixed at the center, and a force is applied at the edge to observe the disc's rotation in the horizontal plane. A steel pipe is inserted vertically into the ground, and a lateral force is applied at the top to observe its tilting process. One side of a rectangular box is fixed, and an upward force is applied to the other side to observe the box's rotation around the fixed point. A ball rolls down a slope, observing the change in rotational inertia as it reaches the bottom of the slope. A T-shaped rod structure is fixed at the center on a horizontal plane, and a force is applied at one end to observe its rotation on the horizontal plane.
